comparison: native saved states and recorded CSV only; no interpolation or renderer comparison

baseline.damageCriterionConvention: max(0, Drucker-Prager(undamaged Kirchhoff stress, stored radian friction angle)); reference-only author-code adaptation, full fracture/run-out unvalidated.
baseline.protectedBaseConvention: Initial y <= soilBoundary is material index1; damage and plasticity remain disabled for this elastic beach.
baseline.statisticConvention: Author-code stabilization adaptation: bulk physical nodal KE/work plus aggregate constrained E^T M E kinetic energy and global displacement dot external work; OOBF uses independent E^T(internal+external) / E^T external L2 norms, excludes damping and dependent exterior DOFs. No volume weighting or literal Eq67 claim.
baseline.viscousDampingConvention: core damping=2*beta; beta_crit=(pi/2)*sqrt(E/(rho*h^2)); settle beta=0.1*beta_crit, dynamic beta=1e-4*beta_crit.
baseline.parameterAmbiguities: Paper Table 5 E=100 MPa conflicts with prose E=1 GPa; Eq19 blend notation conflicts with prose. Effective inputs must be reported.
